issues.legal_issue: A subsequent purchaser may rely on the plaintiff’s failure to establish continuous readiness and willingness in a suit for specific performance when the property was conveyed to the purchaser before the suit was filed.
material_facts: The vendor unequivocally resiled from taking a step toward completing the sale, but the plaintiff took no action for about one year and eleven months before issuing a notice offering the balance consideration.
The property was conveyed to two subsequent purchasers before the plaintiff filed the specific-performance suit.
The plaintiff had not received a conveyance after a decree for specific performance.
issues.conclusion: The plaintiff was not ready and willing throughout to perform the agreement, and the subsequent purchasers could rely on that failure; the suit was therefore barred from succeeding on that basis.
issues.legal_principle: Section 16(c) of the Specific Relief Act, 1963 requires the plaintiff to aver and prove performance or continuous readiness and willingness, and obliges the court to deny specific performance if that requirement is unmet. In Ram Awadh (dead) by LRs v. Achhaibar Dubey, a three-Judge Bench held that any defendant may raise this failure and overruled Jugraj Singh v. Labh Singh. M.M.S. Investments, Madurai v. V. Veerappan was distinguishable because the purchasers there acquired the property after a decree and a conveyance to the plaintiff; here, the subsequent conveyances preceded the suit.

rule.if: specific_performance_suit and subsequent_purchaser_defendant and conveyances_preceded_suit and vendor_unequivocally_repudiated and plaintiff_inactive_after_repudiation

predicates.specific_performance_suit: The plaintiff brought a proceeding seeking specific performance of an agreement to sell.
predicates.subsequent_purchaser_defendant: A defendant acquired the property through a conveyance from an earlier purchaser.
predicates.conveyances_preceded_suit: The conveyances to the subsequent purchasers occurred before the plaintiff filed the suit.
predicates.vendor_unequivocally_repudiated: The vendor clearly refused to take a step required to advance completion of the agreed sale.
predicates.plaintiff_inactive_after_repudiation: The plaintiff took no meaningful step toward completing the sale for a substantial period after the vendor’s clear refusal.
predicates.plaintiff_not_entitled_to_specific_perfo: The plaintiff cannot obtain specific performance because continuous readiness and willingness to perform was not established.

issues.definition: When a plaintiff seeks specific performance, a defendant acquired the property before the suit, the vendor clearly repudiated the agreement, and the plaintiff then remained inactive, the plaintiff cannot obtain specific performance for failure to establish continuous readiness and willingness.

issues.legal_issue: A plaintiff seeking specific performance cannot obtain a decree while known conveyances of the same property remain unchallenged.
material_facts: Before filing suit, the plaintiff knew that the property had been conveyed first to one purchaser and then to another.
The plaintiff did not seek cancellation of either conveyance, although the conveyances remained in force.
issues.conclusion: Specific performance could not be decreed unless the conveyances were set aside; the plaintiff’s failure to seek their cancellation stood in the way of the requested decree.
issues.legal_principle: The court held that, while the conveyances to the subsequent purchasers remain effective, a decree compelling performance of the earlier agreement cannot follow. The plaintiff knew of the conveyances but did not seek their cancellation.

rule.if: specific_performance_suit and property_conveyed_to_others and plaintiff_knew_of_conveyances and plaintiff_did_not_seek_cancellation

predicates.specific_performance_suit: The plaintiff brought a proceeding seeking specific performance of an agreement to sell.
predicates.property_conveyed_to_others: The property was conveyed to persons other than the plaintiff.
predicates.plaintiff_knew_of_conveyances: The plaintiff knew of the conveyances when pursuing the claim for specific performance.
predicates.plaintiff_did_not_seek_cancellation: The plaintiff did not ask the court to set aside the conveyances.
predicates.specific_performance_decree_unavailable_: A decree of specific performance cannot be granted while the conveyances remain effective.

issues.definition: If a plaintiff seeks specific performance, knows that the property has been conveyed to others, and does not seek to set those conveyances aside, a decree cannot be granted while they remain effective.
